en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy European city center with a curved street, tram tracks, and a public square filled with café tables and umbrellas. Multi‑story historic buildings line the street, with shop signs visible on the facades. In the background, a steep hill rises above the roofs, topped with fortifications and a tower. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text identifies the view as "Graz, Hauptplatz – Sackstrasse."
